name: The Rejected: Spinal Crawler
senses: blindsight 30 ft. (blind beyond this radius); passive Perception 11
bio: Someone Must Hurt: user-supplied homebrew for five 8th-level characters using 2014 rules. CR 5 is the source's design estimate, not a playtest result. This is the arching, spine-backed Rejected portrait with the faded anchor tattoo. Close to 5 feet when possible, knock a target prone with Hooked Claw, then bite with advantage while within 5 feet. If the tattoo is Cale's clue, establish Cale's matching tattoo earlier; otherwise it belonged to another patient. This is distinct from the Many-Handed Crawler; do not substitute an ordinary grick.

traits.name: Spider Climb
traits.description: Climbs difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without an ability check.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: Makes two Hooked Claw attacks and one Bone Beak attack.

actions.name: Hooked Claw
actions.description: Average hit damage 11. A Medium or smaller creature hit by this attack must succeed on a DC 15 Strength saving throw or fall prone. Apply advantage or disadvantage for prone manually based on the attacker's distance.

actions.name: Bone Beak
actions.description: Average hit damage 13. An attack from within 5 feet has advantage against a prone target; apply it manually.
